name: Eastern Strand
summary: Daggerspine naga hold the Eastern Strand along Hillsbrad's southeastern coast. The beaches and shallows reach toward the Arathi Highlands border.

sections.title: A Hostile Shoreline
sections.body: The Daggerspine naga hold the Eastern Strand on Hillsbrad's southeastern edge. Across the bay lies the Western Strand. Southshore and Tarren Mill clash over the region's human farms, while the naga dominate these sandy flats and tidelines. They come from the Great Sea, crossing the sandbars and settling among rocky outcrops. From there, they watch the mainland.

sections.title: Daggerspine Territory
sections.body: Daggerspine warriors and spellcasters prowl the beaches and nearby waters southeast of Southshore, making the coast dangerous for travelers.

faq.q: Where is the Eastern Strand located?
faq.answer: The Eastern Strand runs along Hillsbrad Foothills' southeastern coast, toward the Arathi Highlands border.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Eastern Strand?
faq.answer: Daggerspine naga overrun the Eastern Strand's beach and nearby waters, including foot soldiers, raiders, and spellcasters along the tideline.

faq.q: Why are the naga gathering on this beach?
aliases: what are the naga doing here
faq.answer: Daggerspine naga occupy the Eastern Strand's beaches and waters. Their purpose beyond holding this coastal territory is unrecorded in the Classic account.

faq.q: How does the Eastern Strand differ from the Western Strand?
faq.answer: Both strands border Hillsbrad's southern coast. The Western Strand lies southwest toward Silverpine, where Torn Fin murlocs dwell. The Eastern Strand lies southeast toward Arathi, held by Daggerspine naga.

angles.text: Daggerspine naga on the Eastern Strand threaten Southshore's sea defenses and nearby patrols from the flank.
An organized naga advance inland from the coast could disrupt Horde movements and supply lines across lower Hillsbrad.
